indicators.title: Government Relief Fund Impersonation
indicators.description: Fraudulent claim of Benazir Income Support Program disbursement via unverified mobile number.

indicators.title: Unsolicited Contact Directive
indicators.description: Directing recipient to contact a personal mobile number rather than official BISP 8171 portal.

recommendations: Do not call the mobile number provided.
Verify any official BISP assistance strictly via official portal or 8171 SMS shortcode.
Block the sender and report to telecom authority / FIA Cyber Crime Wing.

analyses.content_snippet: URGENT: Your HBL online banking access will be suspended within 2 hours. Click http://hbl-security-portal.online to verify your CNIC and OTP.

indicators.title: Credential & OTP Harvesting
indicators.description: Explicit request to submit OTP and CNIC through an external unofficial domain.

indicators.title: Artificial Urgency Threat
indicators.description: Manufactured deadline of 2 hours designed to induce panic and bypass critical thinking.

recommendations: Never share OTPs, PINs, or CNIC numbers on links received via SMS.
Access bank services only through the official mobile banking app or confirmed domain.
Immediately contact bank customer support if any information was entered.

warnings: Insecure HTTP protocol used for purported banking portal
Deceptive brand token "hbl" registered on untrusted .online TLD

Block the sender phone number / email address and report as fraud to your telecom operator.
